title: Smartphone Trading Technology, Investor Behavior, and Mutual Fund Performance
eligible_reason: Single-date DiD: app release in September 2013 for all investors; treatment = switcher1 (investor who later adopted the app) x common post, on a 1:1 matched adopter/non-adopter sample. post_switcher1 switches on at the same calendar week for all treated investors, so there is one adoption cohort. Columns also add post x baseline characteristics (time-invariant x post, allowed) but Table II cols 1-3 are Poisson (ppmlhdfe); flow regressions interact treat_post with lagged returns/sentiment (continuous interactions); Table III uses continuous smartphone penetration x post; Table IV is fund-group-level post_adopt with a common date.
design_notes: Investor-week (and investor-fund-week, fund-group-week) panels from a Chinese asset manager, 2012-2014, 24,836 matched investors. Figure 2 event study (reghdfe on treat_pre/pos with custno and YM FE) is relative to the common app-release month.
estimators_reported: event study around a common date
ineligible_specs_listed: Table II Panel A cols 1-5: post_switcher1 with post x baseline covariates; cols 1-3 Poisson; single date
Table II Panel B, Table III: treat_post x lagged returns/sentiment; continuous penetration x post
Table IV Panel B: post_adopt at fund-investor-group level; single date
data_files_note: readme.docx: the Advisor prohibits sharing the data or any subset; package has do-file, log and variable list only.
screener_notes: Individual app adoption dates are not used as treatment timing; post is the common release date.
